## Question Groups Identified
- Total of posts found: 50

### Group 1: Regression methods and model questions
- Shared idea: Questions about regression techniques, model components, diagnostics and when/why to use different regression approaches.
- Post IDs: post_16qp1oj - post_k5jvwn - post_15lwjf3 - post_onyzqb - post_1al5ye3 - post_tyyyx3 - post_1hjnau5 - post_v5z98w

- "Stepwise Regression - Dependent Variable?"
- "Self-selecting independent variables for linear regression?"
